title: 'They're kind of goth': NASA spacecraft gives mysterious brown dwarfs a close-up
caption:
NASA's SPHEREx space observatory surveyed dozens of brown dwarfs across 102 infrared wavelengths to study their atmospheric chemistry. The observations revealed wildly varying cloud structures that current planetary climate models cannot account for.

Source: Space - 'They're kind of goth': NASA spacecraft gives mysterious brown dwarfs a close-up
